mentions.name: Kumoss
mentions.description: An open-source, intent-based infrastructure platform that turns natural-language requests into infrastructure changes while keeping validation, compliance and existing engineering workflows in the loop. Developers can request any infrastructure need via a web portal, and the request is automatically fulfilled following the organization standards defined by the platform team.
mentions.audience: Developers who request infrastructure needs through a web portal
